_pruned._comment: Deleted in Phase 6, kept here as the record of what was here and why. tests/assets.mjs asserts every path is still absent, so none of this can come back without this block changing with it.
notes: The Kenney kit shipped one furniture set in five formats. 700 files, 12.8 MB, and GLTFLoader is the only loader in src/ -- nothing here could read a .dae, .fbx, .obj or .stl even if something asked for it.
SchoolDesk_01, SchoolChair_01: an alternate desk/chair style that would compete with the kit already in place.
wooden_bookshelf_worn, Shelf_01, metal_office_desk: same, for storage furniture.
chemistry_set: science-flavored, and no shipped subject is chemistry.
pine_sapling_small: an outdoor prop, 21.9 MB of it, in a game that has never been outdoors. The single largest thing in the tree.
office_notepads: redundant with stationery_supplies, which is placed.
plastic_crate_01: named by nothing, not even the old alternates list.

Every Poly Haven texture set ships a preview sphere: a .gltf and a 2.37 MB .bin beside the textures/ folder. materials.js builds its jpg filenames out of `dir` and `base` and never opens either one, so ten sets carried 23.7 MB of mesh nothing could reach. The jpgs stay; the sphere does not.

_budget._comment: Ceilings in bytes, asserted by tests/assets.mjs and by tests/smoke.mjs. Raising one is the moment an asset argues for itself: say in the commit what the new file buys.
_budget._measured: Phase 6 left this at 62,102,693 bytes referenced across 104 files and 3,745,076 unreferenced across 147, out of 76,685,204 in the tree. It arrived at 149,313,216 bytes across 1,037 files.
